caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick or column-shaped object placed upright on a rectangular, textured base. The object consists of several distinct segments: the topmost part is a brass or gold-colored cylindrical candle holder sitting in a shallow, circular dish with blue and grey accents on its rim; this sits on a narrow neck above a conical, peach or light terracotta-colored shaft. The shaft flares slightly at mid-height, then narrows again before connecting to a bulbous segment that transitions into a greenish cylindrical section, featuring marbled or veined patterns. The base of the candlestick is round and blue, which rests on a larger square platform that appears to be stone or wood, colored in greyish brown. The background is plain and off-white. There is a small inscription near the bottom right, reading "EDWARD T. JEWETT," and the number "17" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Candlestick (Ecclesiastical)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
